Prepare the 2024 dog-license records and the national baby-name reference, then match each estimated dog to the complete baby-name decades from 1880–2019. Neighborhood-income work is deferred to a separate collaboration step.

## Packages and helpers
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
source("helpers.R")
```

# Match dog and baby names
## Match baby names to dogs
Use all complete decades in the reference. Keep a separate yes/no result for each decade so a name can match several generations.
```{r}
#| label: match-dogs-to-baby-names
ssa_reference |>
  select(name, ssa_recognized, starts_with("top100_")) ->
  ssa_name_flags

ssa_name_flags |>
  select(-name) |>
  names() ->
  name_flags

dogs_prepared |>
  left_join(ssa_name_flags, by = "name") |>
  mutate(across(all_of(name_flags), function(name_matches) replace_na(name_matches, FALSE))) ->
  dogs

dogs |>
  select(name, ssa_recognized, starts_with("top100_")) |>
  preview()
```
